narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Four is another even prime, because it is a small even number.
<bookmark mark='count'/>But four has three factors, one, two and four, and a prime has only two.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Being small does not make a number prime, so we must count the factors.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says four is another even prime; the factors 1, 2, 4 are counted as 3 factors; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, pick any even number above two and list all its factors.
<bookmark mark='three'/>You will always find one, two and the number itself, which is more than two factors.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: pick any even number above 2 and list its factors, 1, 2 and itself are always there

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says four is another even prime, because it is a small even number. Four has the factors one, two and four, which is three factors, so the bubble is struck.
